note: Committed before the first held-out run. The held-out issuers are whatever this rule yields on Actions; nothing here names them.

heldout_rule.revision_note: Revision of heldout-2026-11-a (commit 0354141) made before any held-out run: SEC refuses Actions runners, and the frames/submissions APIs that rule a used have no Internet Archive captures. Same exclusions, salt and acceptance idea.

population.description: SEC Financial Statement Data Sets 2026q1, sub.txt: original 10-K filings of large accelerated filers with a December 31 fiscal year end and period 2025-12-31
population.primary_document: FSDS instance '<doc>_htm.xml' names the Inline XBRL primary document '<doc>.htm'

exclude.ciks_note: Microsoft, Apple, AMD and NVIDIA: issuers whose filings the project's document pipeline already uses
exclude.finqa_note: Also excluded: every ticker in the pinned FinQA dev split (data/manifest.json) used by the retrieval lab, mapped to CIKs through SEC's ticker file

order.description: Ascending SHA-256 of salt + 10-digit zero-padded CIK; the salt was fixed in rule a before any run

heldout_rule.source: Latest Internet Archive capture (HTTP 200) of each SEC URL, fetched as original bytes (id_) and checked against the CDX SHA-1 digest; the HTML's own dei:EntityCentralIndexKey and dei:DocumentType must match the candidate

render.engine: Playwright Chromium (headless), network blocked except the saved filing HTML
render.pagination: Page breaks from page-break/break-before/after styles in the filing HTML

statement_pages.rule: For each statement, the first rendered page (document order) holding a non-dimensional fact of its first available anchor concept, on a page with at least min_facts_on_page tagged numbers

scoring.box_recall: visual-evidence-1 selection: an OCR span covers at least 35% of the fact box, or its centre lies inside it
scoring.acceptance: confidence >= 0.90; no selected span more than 8 pt outside the box; exactly one span; no detached sign/digit fragment within 8 pt (word-evidence-1); strict amount grammar (table-lookup-1)
scoring.page_reading: Reference-free from OCR only: nearest '(In thousands|millions|billions ...)' header above; nearest row of 2-6 year headers above, column bounds at header midpoints; rows naming shares, per share or par value abstain on scale
scoring.key: magnitude from the fact's printed text and ixt format; scale attribute; period year = context end date or instant; sign = printed parentheses, with the XBRL sign attribute reported beside it

publish.format: WEBP greyscale with a provenance strip below the page

user_agent_note: Declared on every request. SEC answers GitHub Actions runners with HTTP 403 'Undeclared Automated Tool' whatever the User-Agent or headers (runs 42709826308, 42710194611, diagnostics 42710474268 and 42710749950, 2026-11-09), so the benchmark makes no SEC requests: it reads existing Internet Archive captures of SEC files and checks each against its capture digest. The contact is the project's public GitHub noreply commit identity, not a personal address.
